package.description: A fast, free and open-source media player for Windows.

en-US.description: A fast, free and open-source media player for Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
Darshan Player is a lightweight open-source media player for Windows, built on LibVLC. It plays
common video and audio formats without extra codec packs, including MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WebM,
MP3, FLAC and more.

Features include a 10-band equalizer with presets, subtitle loading with delay adjustment and
appearance options, multiple audio and subtitle track selection, chapter navigation, playback
speed control, A-B loop, frame stepping, crop and deinterlace, picture-in-picture, playlists
with shuffle and repeat, and resume where you left off.
en-US.name: Darshan Player
